description_en: Retrieve the list of project templates

parameters.help_en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: Template type. For this scenario, only "Project" should be specified.
